issues.title: Subagent runs fail with 'model_coming_soon' on MiMo-V2.6-Flash while the main session on the same model works fine

en.headline: 6 commits to sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu, 1 issue comment on opencode
en.summary: On 2026-10-17, the user made **6 own commits** to `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 20 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The commits covered documentation regeneration with a new style, a CI fix for push-failure rebase retries with full history, a render fix enlarging Chinese badge and tag fonts, a summary feature adding a homepage teaser and per-repo deterministic numbers covering all repositories, an AI provider switch from Zen to OpenCode Go (longcat to deepseek), and finalizing `AGENTS.md` with workspace updates and provider ordering. The user also commented on issue `#56113` in `anomalyco/opencode`, which reports subagent runs failing with `model_coming_soon` on MiMo-V2.6-Flash while the main session on the same model works fine; the issue has 6 total comments. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded for the day.
